exposure: uterine artery embolization combined with methotrexate
uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with methotrexate (MTX)
deep implantation cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP II)
outcome: time for serum beta human chorionic gonadotropin (β-HCG) level to normalize
time required for the disappearance of the gestational mass
cohort: 29 patients with deep implantation cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP II)
finding: Although treatment success rate did not differ significantly between the two groups, the surgical treatment for CSP II resulted in decreased blood loss, shorter time to normalize serum beta human chorionic gonadotropin levels, quicker disappearance of the gestational mass, and shorter hospital stay compared to uterine artery embolization combined with methotrexate.
